LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 11.1.1 INTERVIEWS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.1: Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Interviews
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Interviews, part of Strand 11 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why are interviews important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to and review an audio clip on school placement and scholarship interviews,

2. discuss reasons for sitting for a placement and scholarship interview,

3. search online and watch video clips on school placement and scholarship interview,

4. role-play a school placement and scholarship interviews, record and share them via social media channels,

5. conduct mock interviews in pairs or small groups,

6. collaborate with peers to record the interviews on digital devices,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to and review an audio clip on school placement and scholarship interviews,
2. discuss reasons for sitting for a placement and scholarship interview,
3. search online and watch video clips on school placement and scholarship interview,
4. role-play a school placement and scholarship interviews, record and share them via social media channels,
5. conduct mock interviews in pairs or small groups,
6. collaborate with peers to record the interviews on digital devices,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Interviews together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: It is enhanced as the learner contributes to group decision making while discussing in

groups reasons for sitting for a placement and scholarship interview.

• Digital Literacy: It is enhanced as the learner uses digital devices to search online and watch video clips on school

placement and scholarship interviews.

Values:
• Responsibility is achieved as the learner role- plays school placement and scholarship interviews with peers.

• Respect is enhanced as the learner collaborate with peers to record interviews on digital devices and shares with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Peace Education is developed as the learner works in harmony with peers to conduct mock interviews and role plays.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the concept of interviews to the learning of conversational skills in Kiswahili.
